messages:
emily_sales: FYI — Quokka Labs POC kickoff tomorrow but procurement pushed blockers: 1) they require a signed orderform before any billing; 2) DPA contains a broad subprocessor transfer clause; 3) they want customer-managed HSM; 4) EU entity may require wet-ink for the MSA. looping in @noah_legal @rachel_procurement @sam_se @anya_security.

noah_legal: paste the DPA text? if it's a permissive transfer clause we'll propose either: (A) notice + 30-day objection + SCCs or (B) named-subprocessor appendix with consent for additions. I'll draft both.

emily_sales: their snippet: ```"Customer agrees Vendor may engage legacy subprocessors and transfer data across borders without prior notice."```

noah_legal: cannot accept as-is. i'll post two redline options by EOD. also suggest fallback language: allow eSign for orderform to start POC with explicit "POC-only" carveout; require wet-ink MSA for production if customer insists.

rachel_procurement: On signed orderform: we can hold activation until PO/Orderform signed OR accept pre-paid credits (invoice on receipt). Finance prefers pre-bill for pilots. Net30 standard; Net45 needs approval. Recommend adding an overage cap to the orderform (e.g., $2k).

sam_se: Tech: hosted API does not support customer HSM. Dedicated/Private support BYO-KMS/HSM. If HSM required for POC we'll need Dedicated provisioning (lead time ~7-10 business days) and price uplift (~20-30%). Short-term workaround: client-side encryption or scoped managed KMS, but procurement usually pushes back.

anya_security: Need them to complete the security questionnaire and provide SOC2. If EU sub insists on wet-ink, ask for the policy text that mandates it; many accept eSign with audit trail. Link: https://redwood.example.com/sec-qa.

emily_sales: Action items: Noah please drop the two DPA redlines here; Sam confirm exact lead time + delta for Dedicated+HSM; Rachel/Finance confirm pre-bill path and acceptable overage cap; I'll ask the customer for the EU wet-ink policy excerpt and billing contact.

noah_legal: will post redlines by 18:00 PST. Drafts: (1) "Vendor to maintain subprocessor list, provide notice of changes and a 30-day opportunity to object; transfers subject to SCCs or equivalent safeguards." (2) "Named-subprocessor appendix; Vendor to obtain written consent for additions."

sam_se: Confirmed: Dedicated provisioning ~7-10 business days; HSM binding configured during setup. Cost uplift estimate: +25% on POC pricing for typical pilot config. Fast-track possible (~3-5 days) with smaller instance and pre-approval.

essign-bot: Created envelope ENV-13021 for Quokka Labs POC orderform (expires in 12 days). Signers: Quokka PO, emily_sales. Status: pending.

rachel_procurement: If they insist on no billing w/o signed MSA, we require PO before activation. Alternatively, pre-bill credits (Net0) unblocks immediately. Recommend $2k overage cap unless they request higher.

finance_ops: Net45 needs CRO signoff. Pre-bill invoices can be Net0 and acceptable for pilots. If we accept eSign now and they later insist on wet-ink MSA, tag revenue as "POC - eSign limited" to avoid premature production recognition.

emily_sales: Perfect. I'll propose: 1) eSign orderform with pre-billed credits + $2k overage cap to start POC now; 2) collect EU policy excerpt re: wet-ink and offer wet-ink MSA for final contract only; 3) if HSM mandatory, pause hosted POC and move to Dedicated with new orderform (lead time/pricing noted). Sharing Noah's redlines + security questionnaire with their counsel now. Will update thread when they reply. :thumbsup:
